author: Donald Abramsky
text: Been on all 3  the 3 3 plus for 3 years and have never had a sensor fall off.  I wipe  my area to place the sensor with a  alcohol swab. To remove I use alcohol  around sensor.  I also use a plastic cover. Use firm pressure  when applying sensor.

author: Eileen Campbell
text: You don't need a patch if you apply Skintac before you insert the sensor. I have never had one come off using it.
